connection: Direct sqlite3.connect(config.DB_PATH) per operation, closed manually after each call.
queries: Parameterized upsert on stock (sku, quantity), SELECT for stock level, COUNT aggregations for the admin report.
transactions: None explicit; single-statement writes commit per call.

optimization_targets.description: Move the hardcoded admin credential out of source control and load it from the environment with fail-fast validation at import time.
Rebuild the backup shell-out as an argument-list subprocess call with no shell so fixed internal paths cannot be mangled by shell quoting rules.

notes: The backup command targets fixed internal paths only and never includes user input; that property must be preserved. The admin key is compared against the configured secret before any audit data is returned.
